newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Petrochem plans 1.34 bln yuan in 3-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: China Petrochem plans 1.34 bln yuan in 3-yr bonds.

text.p: China National Petrochemical Corporation said on Friday it would issue 1.34 billion yuan in three-year debt and use the funds to finance major petrochemical projects.
The bonds, each with a par value of 1,000 yuan, will carry an annual interest rate of 11 percent, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times newspaper.
The company has appointed China Southern Securities Co and China Guotai Securities as lead underwriters of the offer, which will be made between February 24 and March 15, the statement said.
The bonds will later be listed, it said, adding they would also be traded over-the-counter.

China Petrochemical said the money would be pumped into seven large-scale state petrochemical enterprises, including Maoming Petrochemical Co, Urumqi Petrochemical Plant, Liaoyang Chemical Fibre Co, Jiujiang Petrochemical and Daqing Petrochemical Plant.
